description: Zero-allocation, shared-nothing Zig 0.16 framework: a typed Request/Response API over HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WebSocket and JSON-RPC, served from bounded startup slabs. Each cluster worker runs its own libxev loop and is pinned to a distinct physical core; BoringSSL, lsquic and libdeflate are compiled in. Standard configuration, no tuning.
